title: Strategic ranking
authors: Lydia T. Liu, Nikhil Garg, Christian Borgs
source_version: Proceedings of The 25th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Statistics (AISTATS 2022), PMLR Vol. 151, pp. 2489–2518
main_caveat: All eighteen selected named results have proved endpoints and current independent source-semantic review, final audit, and strict closeout. Proposition 3.1's cutoff-monotonicity clause and Proposition B.2's every-cutoff optimum use explicit local primitive restrictions; known-priority, continuum, and weak/strict readings are clarifications.
human_summary: The finite-level equilibrium exists and is unique almost everywhere under the paper's known-priority boundary model. Main-text weak/strict comparisons are exact under the clarified interpretation, with derivative existence qualified separately. Applicant-welfare cutoff monotonicity and the appendix's every-cutoff weighted optimum use explicit local primitive restrictions. All eighteen theorem targets are proved and independently source-reviewed; final audit and strict closeout are complete.
